scope: Scientific and editorial recheck of authored documentation and its substantive sources. Verification performed 2026-10-21 UTC during the review dated 2026-10-20 in the user’s local date.
limits: Targeted source verification, not a new comprehensive systematic literature review. Historical searches and results are preserved.
full_text means the relevant accessible body was inspected; limitations state partial extraction coverage where applicable.
Metadata-only entries support provenance or attribution only. Published findings do not validate this project’s own results.

references.title: Negative feedback and ultrasensitivity can bring about oscillations in the mitogen-activated protein kinase cascades
supported_claims: Model-based possibility of oscillations from negative feedback combined with ultrasensitivity under specific assumptions.
limitations: Abstract and bibliographic record inspected; exact equations are taken from the separately audited BioModels encoding. No original figure or real-cell behavior is independently validated.
references.citation: Kholodenko BN. (2000). Negative feedback and ultrasensitivity can bring about oscillations in the mitogen-activated protein kinase cascades. European Journal of Biochemistry, 267(6), 1583–1588.

references.title: Effects of sequestration on signal transduction cascades
supported_claims: Explicit binding/sequestration can reduce sensitivity and abolish feedback-associated oscillations in studied cascade models.
limitations: Abstract-level appraisal. This is a conditional modeling result, not a universal absence of biological oscillations or a quantified correction to this implementation.
references.citation: Blüthgen N et al.. (2006). Effects of sequestration on signal transduction cascades. FEBS Journal, 273(5), 895–906.

references.title: Efficient data collection for establishing practical identifiability via active learning
references.authors: Liu X, Wanika L, Chappell MJ, Branke J
supported_claims: Sequential observation choice can be investigated for practical identifiability; the reported E-ALPIPE demonstrations use synthetic experiments.
limitations: This pass rechecked abstract and metadata. The historical review records partial introductory/method access, not full appraisal. This repository’s variance heuristic is not E-ALPIPE and does not inherit its performance.
references.citation: Liu X, Wanika L, Chappell MJ, Branke J. (2025). Efficient data collection for establishing practical identifiability via active learning. Computational and Structural Biotechnology Journal, 27, 4992–5006.

references.title: Curating models from BioModels: Developing a workflow for creating OMEX files
supported_claims: Reproducible simulation needs model files together with simulation settings.
limitations: Abstract and metadata rechecked. Prior review records publisher methods/results appraisal; this pass does not claim a new complete appraisal or a replication of the workflow.
references.citation: Xu J, Smith L. (2024). Curating models from BioModels: Developing a workflow for creating OMEX files. PLOS ONE, 19(12), e0314875.

references.title: Ultrasensitivity in the mitogen-activated protein kinase cascade
supported_claims: Classic modeling and experimental background for cascade ultrasensitivity.
limitations: Abstract-level appraisal; its experiment and larger model are not reproduced. It does not validate oscillations in the selected compact model.
references.citation: Huang CY, Ferrell JE Jr. (1996). Ultrasensitivity in the mitogen-activated protein kinase cascade. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences USA, 93(19), 10078–10083.

references.title: Minimally sufficient experimental design using identifiability analysis
supported_claims: Additional context linking experimental design and identifiability.
limitations: Different model and biological application; abstract-level appraisal only. No method or performance result is transferred.
references.citation: Gevertz JL, Kareva I. (2024). Minimally sufficient experimental design using identifiability analysis. npj Systems Biology and Applications, 10(1), 2.

references.title: BIOMD0000000010: Kholodenko2000 model encoding
supported_claims: Eight species, ten reactions, constants, initial values, conserved layer totals and source formulas used by the translation.
limitations: Official mirror inspected; canonical BioModels route was blocked in initial provenance review. Model annotations are not complete assay documentation, and this snapshot need not represent latest curation.

references.title: BIOMD0000000010 upstream README
supported_claims: Model attribution and the upstream release/dedication notice.
limitations: Unmodified upstream text retained, including its abstract. Installation examples in that historical file are not this project’s instructions.

references.title: BIOMD0000000010 CC0 dedication
supported_claims: The encoded model is released under CC0 1.0 Universal.
limitations: Dedication belongs to upstream model files, not a new dedication of all cited papers.

references.title: SciPy 1.17.0: solve_ivp
supported_claims: ODE initial-value integration, BDF/Radau methods, local error controls and status.
limitations: Official API documentation, not a biological validation or a statistical justification for this dataset.

references.title: Developing a workflow for creating OMEX files: related repository
supported_claims: The related repository exists as supplementary context for Xu and Smith (2024).
limitations: Repository metadata inspected; source code, license compatibility for copying and model-specific outputs were not audited. No code was incorporated.
